title: Seagrove Beach "Changes in Latitude" 40 Hinton Bishop Drive
h1: Seagrove Beach "Changes in Latitude" 40 Hinton Bishop Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Private pool with sitting spa *Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional fee of $75 per day- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 10 adult bikes- Sprawling porches- Elevator- Complimentary beach chair setup includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrella (Available Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complimentary Peloton bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Pool table- Rooftop deck- SONOS sound system- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover Changes in Latitude—where coastal fun meets curated luxury. Accommodating 28 guests in exquisite comfort, this Seagrove Beach home boasts 10 bedrooms, 10 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Savor Emerald Coast views from the sprawling rooftop deck, unwind in the sparkling pool, or indulge in a leisurely afternoon playing billiards. With beach access, Café Thirty-A, and The Perfect Pig within walking distance, this escape is truly unmatched!Entertainment thrives on the first level! Bring a competitive spirit to the billiards table, gather for movie nights, or raise a glass at the 8-seat table beside the wet bar. A complimentary Peloton bike makes it easy to fit in cardio before wandering outside to enjoy the pool, sitting spa, and Summer kitchen. At the evening’s end, choose between 2 guest bedrooms with king beds or a bunk room with two full-over-full bunk beds.Reclaimed oak and weathered wood beams add warmth to the elegant second-level great room. From the living area, the space flows into a dining space, where 2 tables welcome groups of 20. The chef’s kitchen is beautifully designed with quartzite countertops, premium appliances, and a neighboring lounge space. Take morning coffee on the covered patio, featuring Gulf views, a barbecue, a 6-seat table, soft furnishings, and a gated staircase to the pool deck. At bedtime, rest easy in the 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, private bathrooms, and a shared balcony.The third-level living space includes a wet bar, sitting area, and enchanting Gulf views from the stylish patio. Unwind nightly in the primary and guest bedrooms, both boasting a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access. The floor’s first bunk room includes two full-over-full bunks, while the second features a queen-over-queen bunk bed plus 2 full-over-full bunk beds.Breathtaking views and plush lounge areas await on the rooftop deck where guests can get high on red wine and take in the stunning Gulf views.The private Carriage House offers a kitchenette with a microwave, beverage fridge, and coffeemaker, and a guest bedroom with a king bed and balcony.Experience changes in attitude at Changes in Latitude with all the hallmarks of a lavish Seagrove Beach vacation, including on-site parking, 10 complimentary adult bikes, a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, and quick beach access—only a 3-minute walk away on Scenic Highway 30A. Book today and start planning a dream getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 28):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Bedroom: (2)Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Peloton SECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only and Shared Balcony- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only and Shared Balcony- Main Living Area: Kitchen, Living Room and Dining Room THIRD FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only and Shared Balcony- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only and Shared Balcony- Bunk Bedroom: (1)Queen-over-Queen Bunkbed and (2)Full-over-Full Bunkbeds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: (2)Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Living RoomFOURTH FLOOR:- Rooftop Lookout CARRIAGE HOUSE - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo*Fireplace is not for guest use.*Garage is not for guest use.
